title: Orchestrate Helm hooks and values v2 for Private installs
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce a lightweight hook orchestration layer and a backward-compatible values v2 schema for the Private Helm chart to enable staged tenant init, dependency-aware hook ordering, and safer upgrades. Motivation: previous init/rollback behavior was brittle during multi-tenant upgrades and the templating scattered ordering logic across templates; this change centralizes orchestration so chart maintainers and the installer can declaratively express hook dependencies, per-tenant staging, and an opt-in strict mode for major upgrades. Implementation highlights: add charts/private/values.schema.json v2 with explicit hookSections and hookDependencies; add templates/hook-orchestrator.yaml to render an orchestrator ConfigMap and a small controller Job used only during helm upgrade --install; add templates/init-job-stager.yaml which creates per-tenant CronJobs when tenantInit.staged=true; introduce templating helpers for stable hook names and ordering; add a preflight validation template that warns if hookDependencies reference missing hooks; implement a migration path: values v1 -> v2 is auto-upgraded when values.version is unset or set to "1"; if values.version=="2" strictUpgrade=true enables safety gates that block destructive init steps and require a manual approval annotation to proceed. Rollout plan: ship as part of release/1.12, default to values.version=1, opt tenants into staged init by setting tenantInit.staged=true, enable strictUpgrade only for canaries initially. Backwards compatibility: v1 charts continue to render old init jobs; the orchestrator is a no-op unless hookSections or tenantInit fields are present. Includes tests for helm template output and an integration job that simulates tenant upgrade with staged init, and docs/upgrade-guides/private-values-v2.md with recommended strategies and example values.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we avoid creating cluster-scoped resources in the orchestrator? Suggest making the controller Job namespaced and tied to the release namespace.
Aisha Kapoor: Good call — switched to namespace-scoped Job and added a release label for garbage collection. Updated templates and tests.
Sofia Martín: The migration path looks sensible, but please add an explicit opt-out to prevent automatic v1->v2 conversion for existing installs.
Aisha Kapoor: Added values.migration.autoUpgrade boolean (default: true); documented how to opt-out and added test coverage for autoUpgrade=false.
Daan Vermeulen: CI integration flaked on k8s integration; is the test cluster resource consumption under control?
Aisha Kapoor: Reduced test cluster resource requests and added a retry wrapper to the integration job. Observed stable runs after adjustments.
Sofia Martín: Approved after autoUpgrade opt-out and namespace scoping changes; small nits in README corrected.
Liam Chen: Approving — looks good to merge once e2e completes for the release candidate.
release_notes: Introduce values v2 schema to support hookSections and hookDependencies; add orchestrator template to sequence init/rollback hooks; staged tenant init via tenantInit.staged flag; migration.autoUpgrade opt-out added; namespace-scoped orchestrator Job; preflight validation for missing dependencies; upgrade guide in charts/private/README.md; default behavior remains v1 for existing installs.
additional_notes: Rollout recommendation: enable tenantInit.staged on canaries before enabling strictUpgrade; monitor helm-template tests and integration-k8s job; plan a follow-up to expose orchestration telemetry in the console for rollout troubleshooting.
